name: Blackberries of Houston
tagline: Freshly Picked: Houston's Premier Blackberry Harvest Experience
description: Blackberries of Houston is an agritourism farm in 19531 Cypress Church Road, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
